description:
Helping you find the best ways to invest in Real Estate and become financially free. 

My name is Ekow Quagraine.  I’m a serial entrepreneur, and former investment banker based in Johannesburg who has successfully built businesses from scratch. I come from a background of financial struggles, but I'm able to quit my day job in just five years by creating multiple sources of income. This firsthand experience of being under financial pressure has motivated me to help others achieve financial independence too.

My channel's mission is: To help you make money your servant" by blending money with meaning, profits with purpose, street-smart with heart.

Check back for my videos that are posted each week on the topics of real estate, business, finance & legacy building in an accessible, practical way with real life examples & actionable tips. If this interests you, please subscribe to my channel to learn more!

Dedicated to your success. Contact me here: 
https://propertyaskekow.com/contact/
